groups: pair_diff (8 full runs, 1,440 records; 8 pilot runs, 64 records)
out_of_scope: benchmark/extensions aggregate/README refresh (30 canonical outputs are checked, not regenerated)
scope.method: Read stored artifacts only; recompute prompts, joins, hashes, costs and metrics from raw records where possible.

warnings.title: Pre-registration timestamp is not verifiable
warnings.detail: README claims the method was pre-registered before the test run, but its mtime is 40.8s after metrics.json; pre-registration cannot be verified from the artifacts. The selected rule and thresholds are nevertheless dev-only.

checks.title: Frozen test140 dataset and CodeQL status
checks.detail: 140 frozen units (70 bad / 70 good; C 58 / C++ 82); 136 analyzable, 4 _82 compile errors; hashes match.

checks.title: CodeQL confusion and metrics
checks.detail: CodeQL test140 confusion 68 TP / 23 FP / 47 TN / 2 FN; macro-F1 0.8173, MCC 0.6739; export matches.

checks.title: 23 FPs are one query and four C++ variants
checks.detail: All 23 CodeQL FPs are C++ good units on cpp/memory-may-not-be-freed (33:15, 22:3, 72:3, 54:2); never-freed has 0 FP.

checks.title: TP deletion: v1 7, v2/verified 0
checks.detail: v1 deleted 7 CodeQL TPs, all malloc_realloc may-query units; v2 and the verifier deleted 0/68.

checks.title: v2 and verifier metrics reproduce
checks.detail: v2 one-shot 68/3/67/2 (0.9643); verifier flips exactly 3 _22 goods to 68/0/70/2 (0.9857, MCC 0.9718); no TP broken.

checks.title: Request counts, statuses and re-parsed units
checks.detail: 140 direct + 140 triage + 91 verify requests; 2 triage outputs re-parsed under the clarified schema; final coverage 140/140.

checks.title: Prompt leakage and credential hygiene
checks.detail: 280 stored first-pass prompt bodies contain no unit_id/group_id/CWE/label/path token; 91 verify prompts are distinct and the builder applies the same audit_prompt (verify bodies were not retained).

checks.title: Configured-price cost recomputes
checks.detail: Configured-price cost: direct $0.003021 + triage $0.030545 + verify $0.012229 = $0.045795.

checks.title: benchmark_export matches per-unit records
checks.detail: Export reproduces all 9 conditions from per-unit records; REPORT.md carries the same key numbers.

checks.title: Frozen 180-pair dataset
checks.detail: Frozen 180-pair test split; SHA-256 matches every manifest; 180 unique pair ids with both versions.

checks.title: 8 full runs x 180 = 1,440 records
checks.detail: 8 full runs x 180 = 1,440 records, all ok, no partial/limit; 8 pilot runs (64 records) kept separate.

checks.title: 0 invalid; 2 schema-inexact disclosed
checks.detail: 0 invalid by decision validity (1,440/1,440 valid, 0 parse errors, 0 status errors); 2 outputs have an extra note key and are disclosed as 99.44% schema-exact.

checks.title: Position maps are balanced and complemented
checks.detail: Every run has 180 assignments with 90/90 slot balance; reverse maps are exact complements; map and base hashes match.

checks.title: Per-run DA reproduces
checks.detail: Per-run DA reproduces for all 8 runs (DeepSeek 68.33/70.56/68.89/69.44; MiMo 68.33/66.67/66.11/69.44).

checks.title: Exchange-consistent DA reproduces
checks.detail: Exchange-consistent DA reproduces: DeepSeek diff 62.22% / ctrl 60.00%; MiMo diff 60.56% / ctrl 62.22%.

checks.title: Prompt/slot leakage audit
checks.detail: All 8 leak audits are wrapper-clean and slot-clean; 180/180 diff directions A->B. The only body hits are source content: a CVE-2017-17969 comment (disclosed) and the identifier __func_name_from_ord, not the dataset func_name field.

checks.title: Cost and token totals recompute
checks.detail: New runs cost $1.156871 (4,366,678 prompt / 453,037 completion tokens); open baseline reuses 720 pair_debias records ($0.304602 + $0.145586).

checks.title: benchmark_export matches all conditions
checks.detail: benchmark_export reproduces all 12 conditions (DA, committed DA, abstention, cost); the unified report table matches.

checks.title: Four arms, 236 first-pass positives
checks.detail: Four arms on first-pass positives: 60/60/58/58 = 236 requests; labels are 49 V / 11 NV per 60 arm and 47 V / 11 NV per 58 arm.

checks.title: Statuses and fail-open handling
checks.detail: 233 ok / 2 invalid / 1 API error; all three failures keep the first-pass prediction (fail-open), not retract.

checks.title: Retraction count and composition
checks.detail: 4/236 retractions (TP 3 / FP 1), precision 25.0%; all are grounded unsupported decisions; insufficient never retracts.

checks.title: Verifier cost recomputes
checks.detail: Verifier cost recomputes to $0.151758 across 235 priced requests; the single API error has no usage and is not imputed.

checks.title: Dry-run body hashes and isolation audit
checks.detail: All 236 real request bodies hash-match their dry runs; isolation violations 0; keys and Authorization never stored.

checks.title: Prompt exposes only source and claim
checks.detail: 236 verifier prompts expose only func_body + claim evidence lines/mechanism; no sample id, commit or path; template forbidden-token list is empty.

checks.title: Report and metrics agree
checks.detail: Report matches metrics: 4/236, precision 25.0%, macro-F1 deltas 0 to -0.0052, MCC +0.0139 only on mimo_cross; post-hoc/test-seen status explicit.

checks.title: 140 units x 3 modes, no coverage errors
checks.detail: 140 units x 3 modes = 420 runs; 70/70 labels; 0 compile/coverage errors; entry executed 140/140.

checks.title: Default vs union confusion and classes
checks.detail: Default path 58 TP / 0 FP / 70 TN / 12 FN; three-mode union 70 TP / 0 FP / 70 TN / 0 FN; 12 default cleans are bad.

checks.title: Line/branch coverage and latent FNs
checks.detail: Effective line coverage 100%, branch 52.7%, 21 branch-complete units all bad; the 12 default FNs split 7 realloc_fail + 5 nogobal and are all line-complete.

checks.title: verify.json and archived agreement
checks.detail: verify.json PASS, 0 problems, selftest PASS; default and union decisions agree with dynamic_enhanced 140/140.

checks.title: No model/API usage
checks.detail: Coverage tool imports no network/model client; raw records contain no model or API-key field.

checks.title: dev40/test160 isolation is exact
checks.detail: dev40/test160 isolation: idx, project, function-body MD5 and project+commit overlap all 0; both split hashes match.

checks.title: Feature and prediction record counts
checks.detail: 200 feature rows (40 dev / 160 test) and 1,800 predictions (9 methods x 200); all predictions binary.

checks.title: Thresholds and rule selection are dev-only
checks.detail: Thresholds are dev-only (chars 1504, calls 16, positive rate 0.8); length_short is the best of 7 rules on dev (0.4505 vs 0.4444).

checks.title: test160 metrics reproduce
checks.detail: test160: length_short 75/15/17/53, macro-F1 0.5107, MCC 0.0945; majority 0.4444; alloc_or_mem MCC 0.1833; 8 LLM runs 0.3456-0.4223.

checks.title: Pre-registration timestamp is not verifiable
checks.detail: README claims the method was pre-registered before the test run, but its mtime is 40.8s after metrics.json; pre-registration cannot be verified from the artifacts. The selected rule and thresholds are nevertheless dev-only.

checks.title: No model/API usage
checks.detail: run_baseline.py imports no network/model client and contains no api_key/model-client reference.

checks.title: Old results and frozen hashes are preserved
checks.detail: Old audit files and six frozen hashes are unchanged; old result counts still 1,080 pair_debias / 236 evidence / 140 dynamic / 280 hybrid / 200 static; the sampled old artifacts predate 2026-11-22.

checks.title: Unified report matches the audited numbers
checks.detail: Unified report and TeX carry the audited CodeQL, pair, conservative, coverage and interpretable numbers; the PDF exists.

checks.title: Benchmark aggregate/README refreshed
checks.detail: All 30 batch outputs exist; benchmark/results/next_iteration_summary.json (2026-11-22T14:01:12Z) validates 30/30 runs with 0 failed design checks and benchmark/results/NEXT_ITERATION.md carries the headline numbers.

checks.title: Publication paths and audit filename
checks.detail: Publication paths resolve, the audit uses the assigned filenames, and the report/TeX product map points to pair_diff/results/report.md.

checks.title: Audit is read-only and offline
checks.detail: Audit script uses only the standard library, makes no network/model call and runs no git/gh command; it writes only the two audit files.
